orchestrator.name: Orchestrator

market_scout.name: Market Scout
market_scout.role: Picks what the team watches each day

news_intelligence.name: News Intelligence
news_intelligence.role: Reads the news and the event calendar

technical_analyst.name: Technical Analyst
technical_analyst.role: Turns charts into levels and plans

derivatives_sentiment.name: Derivatives & Sentiment

devils_advocate.name: Devil’s Advocate

origin.title: This is the start of {{thread}}
origin.body: Created {{date}}. Atlas keeps every message here, with its time.

empty.title: No messages yet
empty.body: Messages from you, the agents and Atlas appear here, newest at the bottom. Write the first one below.
empty.instBody: Agents open a thread for each instrument they watch. Write below to start this one.

notFound.title: This thread isn’t here
notFound.body: The link may be old, from the other environment, or mistyped. Main has everything the team is saying now.

error.title: Couldn’t load messages
error.bodyBefore: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Check that Atlas is running with

chartEmpty.title: No price history yet
chartEmpty.bodyAfter: appears here once Atlas records its market data.

composer.label: Message
composer.hint: <k>Return</k> to send, <k>Shift</k>-<k>Return</k> for a new line
composer.cantSend: You can write here once the thread loads.

live.backMissed_one: Live again. {{count}} missed message caught up.
live.backMissed_other: Live again. {{count}} missed messages caught up.

empty.title: No open positions
empty.body: Positions on the OKX demo account appear here as soon as Atlas syncs them.

error.title: Couldn’t load positions
error.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Try again in a moment.

corr.cappedTip: Atlas caps a verdict at Weakly supports when fewer than 20 cases back it.
corr.changedTip: Atlas needs at least 20 cases for a strong verdict either way, so it changed this one.
corr.changedOtherTip: Atlas changed this verdict because the evidence didn’t meet its rules.
corr.gapped: Lowered from {{from}}: the backtest data has a gap
corr.gappedTip: Atlas doesn’t accept a backtest claim on data with an unrepaired gap.

hv.noCasesTip: History has no situation like this one in the period searched.
hv.weakTip: Fewer than 20 cases: a hint, not a pattern.
hv.table: What followed, by horizon, against the base rate

col.mid80Tip: 10th to 90th percentile: 8 in 10 cases ended inside this range.
col.roseTip: Share of cases where the price was higher at the end of the horizon.

row.baseTip: Any {{h}} in the same period, for comparison.

hv.stripTip: These cases: median {{a}}. Base rate: median {{b}}.
hv.stopLine: {{stop}} ATR from entry. The median 4-hour range is {{range}} ATR.
hv.overfit: Probably overfit. The rule did much worse on data it wasn’t tuned on.
hv.unv: Not found in any tool output
hv.unvLong: Atlas didn’t find this number in any tool output from this answer.
hv.unvNote_one: {{count}} number in this answer isn’t in the tools’ data. It’s marked.
hv.unvNote_other: {{count}} numbers in this answer aren’t in the tools’ data. They’re marked.

rg.ruleTip: Labelled by rule (ADX and the volatility percentile), so there is no probability.

rt.title: Market regimes
rt.caption: Regime of each instrument. Select a column header to sort.

reason.none: No written reasoning for this answer.
reason.cutIn: Atlas cut this input at 2,000 characters.
reason.cutOut: Atlas cut this output at 2,000 characters.
reason.cutText: Atlas showed the first 4,000 characters of this step. The full reasoning comes with the answer.
reason.cost: {{tin}} tokens in, {{tout}} out, about {{cost}} at API prices
reason.costTip: Agents run on your Claude plan. This is what the same tokens would cost on the API.

run.joined: Atlas joined this run at step {{n}}; earlier steps aren’t shown.

why.rate_limited: Your Claude plan’s usage limit was reached, so this answer stopped. {{name}} waits for the limit to reset; the rest of the team carries on.
why.error: This run failed before {{name}} could answer, so nothing was posted.
why.degraded: {{name}}’s answer failed Atlas’s checks twice, so nothing was posted. {{name}} is now marked degraded.

news_brief.readOn: Read on {{host}} (opens in a new tab)
news_brief.moveTip: {{inst}} has moved {{v}} since this story was first seen at {{time}}.
news_brief.moveNone: No candles for {{inst}} since this story was first seen.

tip.one: Reported by one reputable outlet, {{sources}}. A second would confirm it.
tip.rumour: Unverified: no reputable or official source has carried this yet.

priced.label: Priced in
priced.yesTip: The price has already moved about as far as news like this usually moves it.
priced.partlyTip: Part of the likely move is already in the price.
priced.noTip: The price hasn’t reacted to this news yet.

empty.stories: No new stories in the last {{n}} hours.
empty.top: No new stories since yesterday’s brief.
empty.events: Nothing scheduled in the next {{n}} hours.

deg.title: No {{classes}} news is coming in
deg.body: Every {{classes}} news source is down, so this brief may miss stories. Market Scout caps {{classes}} conviction at {{cap}} until a source works again.
deg.bodySince: Every {{classes}} news source has been down since then, so this brief may miss later stories. Market Scout caps {{classes}} conviction at {{cap}} until a source works again.
